boundaries: Projected valid global type and registry bucket arrays; name bytes encode Latin1 with C NUL termination.
Native type==count executes indexed lookup. Tests allocate the extra readable slot; an absent slot is an unsafe original read, not an invented null result.
Negative counts and record counts preserved. Invalid pointers, concurrent registry mutation and arbitrary callback side effects excluded.
notes: The exact type==count indexed branch is retained when an extra projected slot is supplied; absent slot is explicitly out of domain.
Unknown negative or greater-than-count types scan all registered types in order. Null type table, registry or query returns null.
Null name accessors skip a type, signed nonpositive record counts skip its records, and first matching record wins. Original byte comparator executes unchanged in all native cases.
Accessor native pointer results are represented as object name values in portable code; twelve raw-pointer probes are additional native evidence, not managed equality claims.

Obstacle primary/review suites retain their older lookup adapter; the separate2700-case chain executes original lookup, accessors, comparator, command parsing, control functions and queue insertion without replacement callbacks.
